payload.body: hv, through the Desk (devbin-vc, read 06:46Z by its date -u), verbatim: "Remember, this Intent patch for hash-based IDs is P0, or P(-1). Or however I can stipulate UTTMOST PRIORITY." The Desk's rule from now: (1) an intent-* ask never waits for another estate; it is granted at once on the host and lane its seat names, whatever the load; (2) tell devbin-vc each heavy-class run as soon as you know it, eg "dc: 0711 gate, cargo, ~6 min, asking in ~10 min", and the announcement holds the lane for you; (3) a run already started is not stopped. Rhadamanth's cargo lane is Intent's, one heavy run at a time: cc and dc take turns there, and ic's gyges runs book nothing (vc decision 132).
